The issuer demonstrates strong financial performance with substantial revenue ($12.22B in Q3), a high gross margin of 72%, robust profitability (30% operating margin), and positive retained earnings of $17.09B. However, its capital structure is highly leveraged with total liabilities of $78.29B against shareholders' equity of $18.55B (debt-to-equity ratio of over 4x), and it maintains a relatively tight short-term liquidity position represented by a current ratio of 1.27. This combination of strong operating profitability and high financial leverage aligns with a solid investment-grade rating in the BBB category.

DECISION: BBB
